_comment: The platform's rules over the mothership's own logs. health-manager emit writes one JSON line per health event, identifier tappaas-health (ADR-041 D4). A root cause is mailed; a symptom never is; a silenced event (acknowledged, in maintenance) is recorded and not mailed. Both rules are events: an alert over a log line resolves when its window moves on, not when the root recovers, so the recovery is a line of its own and a mail of its own.

rules.name: health-root-cause
rules.title: HealthRootCause
rules.headline: Root cause
rules.summary: A condition became a root cause: the failure nothing else explains (ADR-041 D3). What it impacts is not mailed separately.

mail.subject: {state}: root cause {label.name} ({label.symptoms} impacted)

rules.name: health-root-recovered
rules.title: HealthRootRecovered
rules.headline: Root cause recovered
rules.summary: A root cause returned to ok.

mail.subject: RESOLVED: root cause {label.name}
